name: Mactan Island
description: A small island in the Visayas. Beach terrain dominates the coastline, with jungle inland. Lapu-Lapu's home ground.
terrain_notes: Heavy beach terrain on east/west edges. Jungle in center. No water tiles (island interior).
loading_tip: Lapu-Lapu was the chieftain of Mactan Island. He defeated Ferdinand Magellan on April 27, 1521 — the first Filipino to resist foreign colonization.
